mission: Deliver a runnable Codex-compatible company AI gateway with centrally managed agents, skills, prompts, and reviewed employee contributions.
acceptance: Admin can manage company-wide agents, skills, prompts, and bindings
Members can submit personal capabilities and admins can approve or reject immutable review snapshots
Local Codex can use the company base URL through the Responses API
Admin can configure one encrypted company upstream provider
Chat composition deterministically injects enabled company capabilities
Provider secrets are encrypted at rest and never returned to the browser
Fresh build, tests, and final diff verification pass
authorityBoundary: No production deployment, remote repository creation, or undefined department and billing semantics without owner authority.
